summary: Filing is a Form 6-K submission by The Toronto-Dominion Bank covering its Q2 2026 interim financial statements for the period ended April 30, 2026. It contains extensive IFRS-based financial disclosures, risk management metrics, pension plan details, and capital instruments information. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is described. This is a routine periodic financial report under the 1934 Act for a foreign private issuer, mapping to a US quarterly report, with no corporate action triggering a special-situation classification.
